Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision
you reported. Can you state where the accident occurred?
A: Yes, it was on the access road near the shopping center in Katy, Texas, around the middle of the afternoon.
Q: Please describe what you were doing right before impact.
A: I was driving in the right lane and wnated to move over to the left lane because the lane ahead was slowing down. I
checked my mirror, put my signal on, and started to change lanes.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?
A: Not clearly. I glanced in my mirror and didn't see anything right beside me, but the other car must have been in my
blind spot. When I drifted over, I felt a bump and heard scraping along the side of my car.
Q: Where on your vehicle did contact occur?
A: Along the driver's side, mostly the rear door and the back quarter panel.
Q: Did either vehicle leave the roadway or strike anything else?
A: No, we both stayed on the road. We pulled onto the shoulder after it happened.
Q: Did you feel any injuries at the scene?
A: I felt a pulling sensation in my lower back right away, but I thought it would pass. By that evening it was much
worse, and I've had stiffness and sharp pain when I bend or lift.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment for your back?
A: Yes, I went to a clinic the next day, and they told me I have a muscle strain and gave me a treatment plan. I'm still
going to physical therapy a few times a week.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want to cooperate fully and I'm willing to provide any records you need.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
